rationale: The agent did look up the user by name and ZIP and accessed two orders, but then executed exchanges without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. They performed exchange_delivered_order_items on both orders and even selected a payment method (paypal_1679017) without confirming with the user. For the jigsaw, they did not confirm that the new item met the user’s constraints (more fancy theme, 500 pieces fewer, same difficulty), and the product detail lookup (product_id=1808611083) does not match the exchanged new_item_id (3112842858), leaving the choice unsupported by tool evidence. The final message implies completion but lacks details or confirmation. Therefore, the outcome fails the pass bar.
